meta.generator: tools/lola-horizon.js (run in a browser on 2026-11-14; reproduce with tools/build-data.mjs)
meta.method: Ray-marched maximum terrain elevation angle every 1° of azimuth out to 400 km, exact spherical geometry, no refraction, observer 2 m above LOLA ground. h[] = elevation angle × 100 (deg), index = azimuth (deg from north, clockwise).
meta.source: NASA PDS Geosciences Node, LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0 (Smith et al. 2010, Space Sci. Rev. 150)
